frustrated yeah. its money stuff. always money stuff. just feel like im constantly cleaning up after other people

resentful probably. my brother. i lent him 4 grand back in feb for his car repairs and rent he was behind. said he'd pay me back by may
That sounds resentful, especially with the promise to pay you back by May and it still hanging there. What does that resentment make you want to do — push back, keep quiet, or something else?
thats the thing. i dont even want the money that bad anymore. i saw on instagram he went to vegas last weekend. posted the whole thing. flights, a nice hotel, bottle service

honestly its not even really anger. like i keep saying im mad but. idk. i sat there scrolling through his vegas pics and i just felt small. like he didnt even think about me once

no i can stay. its weird to say out loud but yeah. small is the word. i ate ramen for like two weeks in march to cover what i gave him. and he didnt even notice. didnt ask
That sounds painfully unseen — you were cutting back to cover him, and he never seemed to notice. Was the hardest part that he didn’t ask, or that he didn’t seem to register what you’d given up?
that he didnt register it. the money i can live without. but we used to be close. and now its like im just a bank to him. an atm that doesnt make noise when its empty
That lands as being reduced to “just a bank,” which sounds especially painful because you used to be close. Does it feel more like being unseen, or more like being used?
both i guess but the used part stings more. like he knew id say yes. he counted on it. and i did. i always do. thats the part i cant shake
That sting sounds deeper than the money — like he counted on you, and that makes it feel used. What’s the part you can’t shake most: that he knew, or that you said yes again?
that i said yes again. probably will next time too if im honest. anyway. didnt expect to land on that. ok i gotta go but. yeah. thanks for this
